name: table-column-width
description: A single table column above a horizontal measurement arrow.
useCase: Adjust the width of selected table columns.
misuse: Give the control an accessible name that specifies the table action.

16.reason: Two stacked cells identify one column. Open cell counters and shallow complete arrowheads keep the dimension clear at text size.

24.reason: Both column edges align with the horizontal arrowheads, and the two open cells retain clear counters.
